CREATE TABLE report_revisions (id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, job_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL REFERENCES jobs(id), company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id), version INTEGER NOT NULL, actor_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, source_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, pdf_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, byte_count INTEGER NOT NULL, pdf_bytes BLOB NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT uq_report_revision_version UNIQUE (job_id, version))
CREATE TRIGGER report_revisions_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON report_revisions BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Report revisions are immutable'); END
CREATE TRIGGER report_revisions_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON report_revisions BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Report revisions are immutable'); END
